title: Louis Prevost, Bunk Johnson and Morris French
summary: Dawson recalls Prevost leaving with Bunk Johnson, and Morris French playing trombone with Kid Rene.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Did you have another guy named Louis Prevost? Prevost.
Yeah, I know Prevost. What happened to him?
I don't know what happened to him.

He went away from here. Long time ago. I think he died. He went, he went, he went, uh, he went away the same time Bunk went away. Bunk Johnson. When Bunk left here, Prevost left. And they went up the line somewhere in different places and stayed away a long time, you see.
We played, uh, Clammer Red I think. Yeah.
What about, uh, Morris French? Did you have another?
Morris French was a trombone player too. Well, Morris French played with Kid René a while too. Mm-hmm. He played with René a while.
